verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is versioned by path (/api/v1/) and its OpenAPI 3.1 spec carries version 1.0.2. However, the same evidence says there is no published deprecation policy or API changelog, and the /changelog path returns 404, so only the versioning half of the story is delivered. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, published API changelog, sunset or migration timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: the API carries path versioning only (/api/v1, spec version 1.0.2) with no published deprecation policy or API changelog
